title: Overview: the big ideas
summary: The chapter's key concepts and how its sections fit together.

blocks.md: Welcome to **Introduction** (Vol I). This overview gives you the chapter's big ideas before the section-by-section lessons. Read the claims once, flip the flashcards, then take the warm-up quiz: it is fine to miss questions here, the lessons that follow fill the gaps.

Machine learning systems have a physics. Data moves through memory hierarchies governed by bandwidth, arithmetic executes on silicon governed by power, and predictions must arrive within strict latency windows. Conventional software can often treat such constraints as implementation details, but in ML systems they decide what can run at all.

rows: Every ML system must show both that its learned behavior is trustworthy and that the machine delivers it within time, memory, energy, and cost budgets, so an accurate but slow model and a fast model trained on unrepresentative data are both failures.

Training data plus the optimization procedure produce the program, so changing the dataset changes system behavior as surely as changing source code, and debugging, versioning, and review must extend to the data.

Attributing a symptom to Data, Algorithm, or Machine chooses the evidence and the class of fix, and relieving the limiting constraint moves the bottleneck across the triad, so diagnosis is a loop of diagnose, intervene, and re-measure.

Across Data, Algorithm, and Machine, execution time factors as samples per task times FLOPs per sample times seconds per FLOP (where the first two multiply to total operations O), and unpacks on hardware into bytes moved over bandwidth plus operations over peak rate times utilization plus fixed overhead, with ideal overlap giving the larger of the first two plus overhead, so a faster component helps only through the share of time it changes.

Data selection cuts samples per task, algorithmic efficiency lowers FLOPs per sample, and compute efficiency lowers realized seconds per FLOP by raising utilization and reducing stalls, while return on compute (accuracy gained per added cost) tests whether an added investment is worth its price.

ML adds a failure route in which code, runtime, and health checks stay green while predictive quality falls as the operating population shifts or training and serving transforms diverge, and locally accuracy falls by a fitted sensitivity times the divergence (eq-degradation), where divergence prompts investigation and labeled outcomes establish loss.

General methods that turn computation into capability have repeatedly overtaken encoded human knowledge, so each AI era traded one limiting constraint for the next and today's limit is the infrastructure: memory, bandwidth, power, and orchestration.

User-visible behavior is produced by the data pipeline, weights, execution stack, serving path, and monitoring loop together, so most of the engineering burden and the costliest failures sit outside the learned parameters, at interfaces no component test exercises.
